sources.name: list
sources.cmd: D={{state}}/widgets/{{widget}}/data; mkdir -p "$D"; cd "$D" && printf '['; s=''; for f in $(ls 2>/dev/null | grep -E '^s(\.[A-Za-z0-9_-]+){9}\.t$' | head -5); do printf '%s"%s"' "$s" "$f"; s=,; done; printf ']'

sources.name: put
sources.cmd: D={{state}}/widgets/{{widget}}/data; mkdir -p "$D"; case "$HATCH_ARG" in s.*.t) ;; *) echo "not a pomodoro state file" >&2; exit 1;; esac; rm -f "$D"/s.*.t; : > "$D/$HATCH_ARG"; printf '{}'

sources.name: notify
sources.cmd: command -v hatch >/dev/null || { echo "the hatch command is not on the server PATH" >&2; exit 1; }; hatch notify "$(printf '%s' "$HATCH_ARG" | tr _ ' ')" --level done --state {{state}} >/dev/null || exit 1; printf '{}'
